name: smart-bazar-Api
description: SmartBazar microservices: API gateway + auth + product (catalog) services

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,product,user,order,cart,payment -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,red,white "npm run dev -w @smartbazar/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @smartbazar/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @smartbazar/product-service" "npm run dev -w @smartbazar/user-service" "npm run dev -w @smartbazar/order-service" "npm run dev -w @smartbazar/cart-service" "npm run dev -w @smartbazar/payment-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartbazar/api-gateway && npm run build -w @smartbazar/auth-service && npm run build -w @smartbazar/product-service && npm run build -w @smartbazar/order-service && npm run build -w @smartbazar/cart-service && npm run build -w @smartbazar/payment-service
